faq_heading: Chilliwack Proper West houses: your questions answered

faq.q: What did houses in Chilliwack Proper West sell for?
faq.a: 46 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper West between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $697,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: The median was 26 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.6% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Chilliwack Proper West sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 46 houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper West went for between $642,500 and $751,125, around a median of $697,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Chilliwack Proper West sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 46 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 96.6% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Chilliwack Proper West?
faq.a: The median year built was 1968 for the 46 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper West.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Chilliwack Proper West usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Chilliwack Proper West had 3 bedrooms, from the 46 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

What Chilliwack Proper West houses sold for, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

46 houses sold in Chilliwack Proper West with a median price of $697,000 (the middle half sold between $642,500 and $751,125), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 96.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median $402 per square foot, a median year built of 1968 and a median lot of 6,852 square feet.

blocks.text: How Chilliwack Proper West compares with the rest of Chilliwack

The median house in Chilliwack Proper West sold for $697,000, 16% below the Chilliwack median of $825,000 across 294 sales. Chilliwack Proper West houses took a median 26 days to sell, against 26 days for Chilliwack as a whole.
